summary: The Gateway no longer requires a per-invocation native Pulse lease (with a second allowlist re-read) before interpreting a Pulse room message. The room stays admitted at its turn (NativePulseContact) and the Python transport still re-reads the sealed contact evidence at every send; the Gateway keeps only the admitted Gemini profile and a Pulse-only catalogue. The room failure table names an unanswered interpretation and generation_context_changed instead of the generic text.
reason: S24 28/10 15:06 and 29/10 15:28Z (Sadok): every Pulse room message was refused by the Gateway in 3 ms (« native Pulse admission required », then « native Pulse model not admitted »); the room has not worked since the L5 refonte. Amine 29/10: align the room on his path and remove superfluous constraints. Paired with playbooks #346.

The room keeps the single admitted Gemini profile (DATA01).
Full canonical CI on the final head and a live recette with Sadok remain required.
